Extract og:title, og:description, and og:image from Open Graph meta tags

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<html><head><title>Fallback Title</title><meta property=\"og:title\" content=\"OG Title\"><meta property=\"og:description\" content=\"OG description text.\"><meta property=\"og:image\" content=\"https://example.com/image.jpg\"></head><body><p>Content</p></body></html>", ConversionOptions.builder().build());
        System.out.println(result.content());
        System.out.println(result.metadata().document().openGraph().get("title"));
        System.out.println(result.metadata().document().openGraph().get("description"));
        System.out.println(result.metadata().document().openGraph().get("image"));
    }
}
```
